# sha256 provenance for the Q_7 search (recorded 2026-10-02, after the blind audit asked for it).
# The production binaries were built on the search machine with gcc -O3 -march=native, so a rebuild elsewhere
# will hash differently; the blind audit rebuilt edimsearch from the deposited source on the same machine and got
# a byte-identical binary. The representative files are regenerated by src/orbreps (Section 7.2 of the note);
# the audit regenerated reps_n6_a0..10 byte-identical to these.
